<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Products\Tables;

use App\Models\Category1;
use App\Pim\Filament\Tables\Category1Column;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Actions\ManageAssetsAction;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Pim\Filament\Tables\GlobalId;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class ProductsTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->modifyQueryUsing(fn (Builder $query) => $query->with('category2.category1'))
            ->columns([

                Category1Column::make('category2.category1.name'),

                TextColumn::make('category2.name')->label(__('product.category_2'))->sortable()->toggleable(),
                TextColumn::make('name')->label(__('digital-hub::fields.name'))->searchable()->sortable(),
                GlobalId::make(),
                TextColumn::make('productType.name')->label(__('product.product_type'))->badge()->sortable()->toggleable(),
                // TextColumn::make('environments.name')->label(__('product.environments'))->badge()->toggleable(),
                TextColumn::make('properties.sku')->label(__('product.attributes.sku.label'))->toggleable(),
                TextColumn::make('created_at')->label(__('digital-hub::common.created_at'))->dateTime()->sortable()->toggleable(isToggledHiddenByDefault: true),
            ])
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make('category1')
                    ->options(fn () => Category1::orderBy('name->it')->pluck('name', 'id'))
                    ->query(fn (Builder $query, array $data): Builder => $query->when(
                        $data['value'],
                        fn (Builder $query, $value) => $query->whereHas(
                            'category2',
                            fn (Builder $query) => $query->where('category_1_id', $value),
                        ),
                    ))
                    ->label(__('product.category_1') . 'a')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload(),
                SelectFilter::make('category2')
                    ->relationship('category2', 'name', fn (Builder $query) => $query->orderBy('name->it'))
                    ->label(__('product.category_2'))
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload(),
                SelectFilter::make('productType')
                    ->relationship('productType', 'name')
                    ->label(__('product.product_type'))
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload(),
                /* SelectFilter::make('environments')
                    ->relationship('environments', 'name')
                    ->label(__('product.environments'))
                    ->multiple()
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload(), */
            ])
            ->digitalHubTable([
                ManageAssetsAction::make(),
            ])
        ;
    }
}

content.text:
Fatto. Il problema era l'import sbagliato in [ProductsTable.php:14](app/Filament/Resources/Products/Tables/ProductsTable.php#L14): veniva usato il **contract** `Illuminate\Contracts\Database\Eloquent\Builder`, che è un'interfaccia quasi vuota e non dichiara i metodi Eloquent (`with`, `when`, `whereHas`, `where`, `orderBy`...). Intelephense quindi li segnalava come undefined su tutte le closure tipizzate con quel `Builder`. Ho sostituito l'import con la classe concreta `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder`, che è anche il tipo usato nei docs di Filament — nessun'altra modifica necessaria, le closure restano identiche.

Era l'unico file del progetto (app + packages/digital-hub) a usare il contract, quindi non c'è altro da sistemare.

PHPStan (`composer analyse`) non segnala nulla su questo file. Riporta però 2 errori pre-esistenti e non collegati in `packages/digital-hub/src/Filament/DigitalHubPlugin.php` (righe 196 e 205: un return type inutilizzato in una closure e un `mixed` passato a `e()`). Se vuoi li sistemo, dimmi tu.
